metadata.description: Live a life medieval with the unforgettable RPG experience of Kingdom Come: Deliverance II. Immerse yourself in a thrilling adventure - through the eyes of Henry - as you embark on a quest of epic proportions. The Royal Edition includes the base game, all the exciting story DLC and additional expansion sets to make your Middle Ages journey truly unforgettable. Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Royal Edition contains: -Gallant Huntsman’s Kit -Shields of Seasons Passing -The Lion’s Crest - Brushes with Death - Legacy of the Forge - Mysteria Ecclesiae
metadata.notes: DLCs won't work if the account you are launching the game from was never online before. You would need to run the payload np-fake-signin-ps5 before then.
